programme.desc: It's time to meet the first World Cup finalist. The current world runners-up and European champions will face each other at Dallas Stadium. Ultimately, it was La Furia Roja who left the pitch victorious, beating their rivals 5-4. Who will come out on top this time? Will the team from the Iberian Peninsula advance to the World Cup final for the second time in history, or will the Tricolor team do it for the fifth time?

In 1966 they managed to win the title. Will they have a chance to repeat this success after 60 years?

For the second time in a row, we will see the Argentine national team in the World Cup final. Leo Messi and company have a chance to become the third team in history to defend the title. However, it will be very difficult because the current European champion, Spain, is facing them. Luis de la Fuente's players played brilliantly in the semi-final, neutralizing all the French's advantages. If they repeat this against Argentina, they will win the second World Cup in their history

programme.title: Lycaons: herd vs. rest of the world 2 – Kakumbi are in trouble | S02E04
programme.desc: Filmmaker and documentarian Julz Braatvedt again visits the charming areas of South Luangwa National Park in Zambia. He observes the everyday life and habits of three herds of wild wild lions and their interactions with other representatives of the local fauna. Viewers will see how the Kakumbi, Manzi and Kakula teams cope with the challenges of Zambian nature. Kakumbi pack puppies fight a warthog. Julz and Henry witness this. A lion specialist counts the families that force Manzi to leave their territory. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions - The way to the top | E01
programme.desc: The life story of young lions. The everyday challenges they have to face throughout their adolescence will be shown. Triumphant moments after hunting will be presented, as well as the dangers they are exposed to. The hunting process of young lions will be presented, as well as the discovery of new areas. The camera also captures conflicts between them, when the mother returns to her children with a new offspring. Germany. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Deadly Weather 2 | S02E10
programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. A fire in the Great Smoky Mountains National Park in eastern Tennessee dramatically interrupts the Thanksgiving holiday, forcing hill residents to flee through burning forests. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Nile: the final river – On wild waters | E02
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. The Victoria Nile creates foamy rapids and waterfalls. In South Sudan, Africa's largest wetland area is being created - the Sudd, which is inhabited by, among others, antelopes, great herons and shoebills. From its source in East Africa to the deserts of Sudan, the Nile flows through a wide strip of the wildest nature. Hippos and crocodiles live here. Over 400 species of birds breed and hunt along the Victoria Nile, including: African razorbills and white-bellied storks. During the dry season, giant elephants search for water in grassy areas. North of the Nile, the hilly savanna is noteworthy - the home of a rare species of antelope: the kobus. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.title: Lycaons: herd vs. rest of the world 2 – Tragedy in the Kakumbi herd | S02E05
programme.desc: Filmmaker and documentarian Julz Braatvedt again visits the charming areas of South Luangwa National Park in Zambia. He observes the everyday life and habits of three herds of wild wild lions and their interactions with other representatives of the local fauna. Viewers will see how the Kakumbi, Manzi and Kakula teams cope with the challenges of Zambian nature. Julz decided to help put tracking collars on the lions. Simon comes across a seriously injured pup from the Kakumbi herd. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Lycaons: herd vs. rest of the world 2 – Manzi: superherd | S02E06
programme.desc: Filmmaker and documentarian Julz Braatvedt again visits the charming areas of South Luangwa National Park in Zambia. He observes the everyday life and habits of three herds of wild wild lions and their interactions with other representatives of the local fauna. Viewers will see how the Kakumbi, Manzi and Kakula teams cope with the challenges of Zambian nature. The Kakumbi pack is mourning the loss of two puppies. During the journey to their cave, the camera comes across a hyena lair and lions hunting. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 6 – Bone Breaker | S06E02
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits various parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Someone finds a body with unusual injuries. Jeremy starts looking for another river monster. He learns about a series of unexplained disappearances and a mysterious creature living in the river. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: In the Shackles of Frost 4 – Trauma | S04E11
programme.desc: The fourth season of the documentary story about the fate of the inhabitants of Alaska. Sue Aikens, Jessie Holmes, Glenn Villaneuve and the Hailstones try to survive the harsh winter. For another year in a row, they take up the challenge nature throws at them. The Hailstones are working hard to develop the land they inherited from Agnes' grandparents. Jessie, on the other hand, takes part in a moose hunt. It soon turns out that he is not the only one looking for these deer. Spring is coming. Alaskans must face new problems. Glenn suffers a foot injury. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Nigel Marven's Wild Central America 2 – Wild Costa Rica | S02E02
programme.desc: British actor and zoologist Nigel Marven sets off on a journey to Central American countries to discover the beauty of the local wildlife and the culture of the inhabitants of these areas. Viewers will cross the Darién Isthmus, see the ruins of Mayan cities and stand at the foot of active volcanoes in Guatemala. They will meet unusual animals, including: a giant eagle, colorful quetzals, frog-eating bats, leatherback turtles, royal condors and the most beautiful heron in the world. They will also learn what residents and scientists say about the richness of fauna and flora there. Nigel Marven invites viewers on an expedition to Costa Rica, during which they will encounter the diverse and colorful nature of this country. They will see a yellow-winged macaw on the Osa peninsula, playful spotted dolphins in Golfo Dylce, a fierce horned macaw on the Caribbean coast and royal condors in the north of the country. Residents and scientists will tell the presenter about Costa Rica's natural treasures. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Umag Tournament (T2026): Mérida – Dzumbur
programme.desc: «Meeting: London» The Diamond League will once again be one of the great focuses of athletics in the 2025 season. There will be 14 events spread across Europe, Asia, Africa and the United States, with the grand final returning in Zurich (Switzerland) on August 27 and 28. A circuit that this year will celebrate its finale before the Tokyo World Championship which is scheduled for mid-September

programme.title: Diamond League (T2026): Londres
Bakalá (S25/26): Episode 4
programme.desc: «The Others (4): Bomb Transfers» That signing that was going to change the history of the club and did nothing. That other one from whom you didn't expect anything and confirmed the expectation. Very expensive signings with unprofessional lives or intrastories of inexplicable signings. Those other signings as unforgettable as they are incomprehensible

programme.title: The Others (S4): Bomb Transfers
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Romario in Spain» The footballer who was defined by Jorge Valdano as “a cartoon” is today one of the most respected political figures in his country. Ronald Koeman, Michael Laudrup, Jorge Valdano come to this Plus+ Report to remember the Brazilian's time in LaLiga. They and those who dealt with him the most on and off the field review the mark that the Brazilian left in both Barcelona and Valencia, the two cities that enjoyed one of the greatest footballers.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Romario in Spain
programme.desc: «Kroos. Family and football» Toni Kroos' path to success, but also the price that each member of the family had to pay for it. A rare and unusually open look at the mental life of a famous family of athletes. In professional football, only the surface is usually exposed to the outside world to protect the brand

programme.title: Kroos. Family and football
programme.desc: «Blaugrana revolution» A chronicle of the great 2024/25 season of FC Barcelona and the explosion of its young figures. The arrival of Hansi Flick to the bench raised questions in a club undergoing serious financial problems. The German coach decided to give flight to the young footballers trained in the club's youth system, with the destabilizing Lamine Yamal at the helm. The result is this Barça: a signature team that has won three domestic titles (League, Copa del Rey and Super Cup) and has reached the semifinals of the Champions League. And all this with a football proposal as bold as it is attractive. The program has the analysis of prominent journalists and also the testimony of Marc Serra, coordinator of the Alevín category of FC Barcelona, ​​who directed from a very early age the majority of youth players who today shine in the first team.

programme.title: blaugrana revolution
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Muriqi the pirate of Kosovo» Vedat Muriqi represents an endangered species. He is the classic number nine, finisher, all-powerful in the attack of Mallorca and its team, Kosovo. But his story goes beyond mere sporting success. On his path to stardom he had to overcome the conflict that would ravage his country in the late nineties and a post-war period that was almost more complicated than the conflict itself.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Muriqi the pirate of Kosovo
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Manuela Vos. Breaking down limits » Manuela Vos's life began again on July 5, 2021. A climbing accident in the Picos de Europa caused her serious injuries. The Dutch woman, who ran marathons and Ironmans, who found peace and refuge in the mountains, became quadriplegic. Iconic photographs of our sport » If you close your eyes and think about the moment that best summarizes Leo Messi's career, you will probably visualize a photo of the Argentine with his fist raised, his gaze lost, and his body supported by a small congregation of devoted hands. Many of the happiest, most shocking or surprising memories of our football are related to a specific photograph, one capable of revealing a moment forever, of reaching the iconic category in the collective imagination. But the stories and circumstances behind each of them are also extraordinary. That is why we have met with their authors, the photographers, to look again, although from another perspective, at Johan Cruyff's flight, Leo's ecstasy, Santillana's flights, the suckling pig's head and many others that are already part of the history of football.

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Philly Special
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: In ancient times, the Mediterranean region was home to the greatest civilizations this world has ever seen. Dir.: Michael Davies, Christopher Riley, Sophie Elwyn-Harris. Led by: Craig Sechler. USA, UK

programme.title: d/s Drain The Oceans (Gulf of Mexico)
programme.desc: The series tells the secret and bloody history of North America, with all its wars, the slave trade, the rise of trade, oil production and even the extinction of the dinosaurs, which can only be fully understood by looking deep under the water. Dir.: Michael Davies, Christopher Riley, Sophie Elwyn-Harris. Led by: Craig Sechler. USA, UK

programme.title: d/s Drain the oceans (Largest warships)
programme.desc: Marine archaeologists and historians set out to unravel the mysteries of the Battle of Jutlad, hidden deep under water. Scientific data combined with computer graphics allow the North Sea to be "drained" to explore the remains of the megaships that took part in the First World War and find out what happened to them after the cannonade ended. Dir.: Michael Davies, Christopher Riley, Sophie Elwyn-Harris. Led by: Craig Sechler. USA, UK

Africa's Hunters: Kimba's Rise (S3 E1). Documentary about nature. USA, 2018. S3, Ep1
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S3, Ep1 «Africa's Hunters»…While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba pride's nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetitesLarge carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's HuntersDirector: Hannah Hoare

programme.title: Baby Animals: Mother's Darlings (S1 E2). Documentary about nature. USA, 2020. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: JAV. Год: 2020. S1, Ep2 «Baby Animals»…Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones, from a ring-tailed lemur who learns everything from its mom to a tiny orangutan that receives a constant supply of motherly cuddlesArctic foxes, sea otters, tamarin monkeys and red pandas are just some of the tiniest, cutest creatures featured in Baby Animals. With their big eyes and wobbly first steps, nature's newbies are irresistible. Watch how animals nurture their young as infant elephants, baby bison and rambunctious rhinos all eat, sleep and play their way to adulthood in their respective natural habitats. Cuddly, clumsy and full of mischief, the babies of the animal kingdom certainly make up the wildest daycare you've ever seen. Find out how it all happens

programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep2 «Big Cat Country»…The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomad's brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down preyBig Cat Country is a documentary series revolving around two neighbouring lion prides of the great rift valley, in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Wildlife film-makers Nathan Pilcher and Sam Davies are in the middle of the action. Watch the big cats facing the greatest challenge of their lives, fighting for the hunting territory and their place in the sun, looking for mates and struggling for their lives, bonding together in order to survive and defend themselvesDirector: Beth BrooksCast: Irvine Iqbal

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Bears on the Move (S2 E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep4 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Beni and Lala are going stir crazy in the sick bay, but they must recover before returning to the rough and tumble of class. And at forest school, a termite-foraging lesson inspires class clown Valentino to make a finger-licking discoveryCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Director: Judith CurranCast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Shark Squad: Island of the White Shark (S1 E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2018. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2018. S1, Ep1 «Shark Squad»…Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its preyNot since the trio of Chief Brody, Matt Hooper and Quint have we seen a group of experts take on one of the ocean's most feared hunters; sharks. The enthusiastic shark-lovers risk their lives for the sake of science, as they explore the migration, behaviours and diets of these underwater apex predators. With many shark species threatened by human activities, it's vital that we learn more about these prehistoric animals, with many being descendants from the Jurassic period. The team head to Guadalupe and the Bahamas, using ultrasonic tagging equipment to track Great Whites and Tiger sharksDirector: Dan Hughes

programme.desc: Jaime cần đến sân bay ở Coron, nhưng trước tiên, cô phải leo lên một vách đá, lặn tìm xác tàu và vượt qua một đàn bò bướng bỉnh.

programme.title: RIDE N' SEEK WITH JAIME DEMPSEY S5 EP06
programme.desc: Jaime đến Batanes và được làm quen với nền văn hóa độc đáo của bộ tộc Ivatan bằng một cuộc lao vào một con bò điên cuồng!

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S3 EP06
programme.desc: Từ kế hoạch dọn dẹp bờ biển kết thúc bằng một bất ngờ chấn động địa cầu cho đến cách giải quyết một vấn đề không ngờ tới của kẻ chạy trốn, đây là những khoảnh khắc trong đời thực mà mọi người đều có những suy nghĩ vượt trội.

programme.title: THE PICKERS S26 EP399
programme.desc: Ở L.A., Mike và Robbie quay trở lại một doanh nghiệp demo thế hệ thứ năm và bãi phế liệu chất đống sâu đến mức hầu hết kho báu của nó đều nằm ngoài tầm với.

programme.title: THE FOOD THAT BUILT THE WORLD S5 EP06
programme.desc: Một nhà khoa học và doanh nhân hợp tác để phát triển khẩu phần chiến tranh giàu vitamin C cho quân đội chiến đấu trong Thế chiến 2, điều này bất ngờ dẫn đến sự phát triển của nước cam cô đặc đông lạnh.

programme.title: HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID S2 EP12
programme.desc: Có một số thành trì được xây dựng để bảo vệ sự thiêng liêng. Nhưng có những thứ khác được sử dụng cho những mục đích độc ác hơn. Trong tập này, chúng ta khám phá những câu chuyện đằng sau một số công trình kiến ​​trúc hùng vĩ nhất thế giới.

programme.title: PAWN STARS S24 EP617
programme.desc: Khi một người bán bước vào cửa hàng với chiếc mũ 'Energy Dome' được sản xuất cho ban nhạc DEVO, liệu sản phẩm của Rick có đứng đầu bảng xếp hạng không? Sau đó, Corey bắn vào bộ bình gạn được cho là của Buffalo Bill.

programme.title: MYSTERIES UNEARTHED WITH DANNY TREJO S1 EP02
programme.desc: Từ các văn bản tôn giáo cổ được chôn cất ở Ai Cập đến các di tích văn hóa được tìm thấy trên biển, hay thậm chí là tháp đầu lâu ẩn dưới lòng đất - những đồ tạo tác bị thất lạc này đã thay đổi những gì chúng ta nghĩ rằng chúng ta đã biết về một số niềm tin nhất định.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S5 EP03
programme.desc: Hầu hết mọi người đều biết đây là nơi sinh ra trong Kinh thánh của con người. Nhưng Vườn Địa Đàng có thực sự chỉ là một câu chuyện giải thích về sự sáng tạo? Hoặc nó có thể là một nơi thực sự? Và nếu nó tồn tại – chính xác thì nó ở đâu?

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP17
programme.desc: Chiến dịch Thái Bình Dương đạt đến cơn sốt tàn khốc và đẫm máu từ năm 1944 đến năm 1945.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP18
programme.desc: Cuộc chiến ở châu Âu lên đến đỉnh điểm khi quân đội Đồng minh tiến về Berlin và Hitler ra lệnh cho người dân của mình chiến đấu đến người cuối cùng.

programme.title: SPECIAL FORCES S1 EP01
programme.desc: Từ khóa học tấn công Tarzan cao 10m so với mặt đất đến cuộc hành quân bắt buộc dài 160km, các tân binh của đơn vị Lực lượng đặc biệt của Quân đội Malaysia, Grup Gerak Khas, bị đẩy đến giới hạn của mình để giành được Mũ nồi xanh đáng mơ ước.

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP10
programme.desc: Nhóm nghiên cứu tập trung vào hòn đảo Bermuda - tên gọi của Tam giác - và một trong những bí ẩn khét tiếng nhất đã giúp tạo nên danh tiếng đen tối cho vùng biển này.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S14 EP10
programme.desc: Pickle hợp tác với Jacob và gần giống như đang đi nghỉ. Zak cố gắng bù đắp một sai lầm nghiêm trọng. Bruce dấn thân vào lãnh thổ chưa được khám phá. Ashley để mắt đến những con cá sấu khổng lồ trên cạn.

programme.title: BÃO TỐ BANGKOK - BANGKOK STORM
programme.desc: Võ sĩ ngầm Lin Feng bị bộ ba Bangkok truy lùng khi từ chối đấu trong một trận đấu trái luật. Anh trốn thoát thành công nhưng bị mất trí nhớ. Trong khi Feng bắt đầu cuộc sống mới, hội tam hoàng tìm thấy anh và thuê một võ sĩ hàng đầu để đánh bại anh. Khi Feng đột nhiên lấy lại trí nhớ trong quá trình đó, anh thề sẽ tiêu diệt bộ ba.

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH 2 - THE GREY MEN 2
programme.desc: Ông trùm Hội Tam Hoàng Song tìm cách xóa sạch hình ảnh của mình và chiếm lấy ghế thị trưởng của Laika trong bối cảnh chế độ đang thay đổi. Anh ta phải đối mặt với sự thiếu hụt kinh phí mặc dù đã thông đồng với các quan chức, đồng thời được cánh tay phải và người thi hành án của mình phạm tội để tăng cường quỹ và quyền lực của anh ta. Ngay khi Song tin rằng thành công sắp đến thì động lực giữa ba người lại có một bước ngoặt bất ngờ…

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!
